About the Role

We are seeking a strategic, creative, and highly experienced Head of Communications to lead and scale Tailscale's global communications function. This leader will shape how Tailscale is understood by the market, elevate our visibility in the media, and build the communications engine needed to support our next phase of growth.

Tailscale is a multi-product secure connectivity platform spanning networking, privileged access, workload connectivity, and AI infrastructure. We have an opportunity to help define the future of secure connectivity, establishing Tailscale as the obvious and best networking choice for AI and agentic infrastructure. We're looking for someone who can turn our technical innovation, customer impact, and vision into compelling stories that earn attention and establish Tailscale as a category leader.

Reporting to the SVP of Marketing, you will own product and corporate communications, public relations, media strategy, internal communications, crisis communications, award applications, international comms and media relations, new media engagement, and executive communications across the leadership team outside the CEO. You'll also partner closely with a separate dedicated CEO and policy communications leader to ensure our stories are coordinated and consistent.

This is a builder role for someone who combines strong strategic judgment with exceptional execution. You will initially be hands-on while hiring and developing a small, high-performing team. You will work directly with leaders across Product, Engineering, Marketing, People, Legal, and the executive team to build a communications function that can scale with Tailscale's ambitions.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute Tailscale's global communications strategy, strengthening brand awareness, reputation, and market leadership.

• Lead product and technology communications, translating complex innovations, product launches, and customer stories into compelling narratives that earn meaningful media coverage. This should include sustained product storytelling between launches, including through independent reviews, technical publications, comparisons, creators, and third party validation. It could also include research-led PR. 

• Build strong relationships with top-tier business, technology, cybersecurity, and AI journalists, driving proactive media opportunities and increasing Tailscale's share of voice.

• Expand Tailscale's presence across emerging media channels, including influential podcasts, newsletters, creators, and technical communities.

• Own corporate communications for major company milestones, strategic partnerships, funding announcements, and other business developments.

• Build and scale international communications programs, including regional media relations and agency partnerships.

• Develop executive communications and thought leadership programs for the leadership team outside the CEO, including speaking opportunities, media engagements, and executive social presence. Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications lead to coordinate company narratives, major announcements, and executive engagement, building comms campaigns for executives that align with the overall company narrative.

• Oversee internal communications, partnering with People and executive leadership on company-wide messaging, all-hands, organizational changes, and employee engagement communications.

• Lead crisis communications, establishing response plans and partnering with Legal, Security, Engineering, and leadership to protect customer trust and company reputation. You should be able to improve processes over time as we scale. 

• Own Tailscale's awards and recognition strategy, identifying and securing high-value industry and company accolades.

• Hire, manage, and develop a high-performing communications team while overseeing external agencies, communications processes, and performance measurement. This team will start small (likely 2 heads), but has the potential to grow in the future as we scale. 

• Partner closely with the dedicated CEO and policy communications individual contributor to maintain consistent narratives and support broader policy communications initiatives.

What We Are Looking For

• 10+ years of experience in public relations, product communications, or corporate communications, ideally within high-growth B2B technology companies.

• Proven track record of securing meaningful earned media coverage and building strong relationships with influential journalists.

• Deep product communications expertise, with the ability to translate complex technical products into clear, compelling stories.

• Experience hiring, managing, and developing communications professionals and overseeing agency partners.

• Exceptional writing, storytelling, and editorial judgment across external, executive, and internal communications.

• Experience advising senior executives and navigating high-stakes or sensitive communications situations.

• Strong strategic judgment and operational discipline, with the ability to prioritize, build scalable processes, and measure impact. Curiosity around and openness to leveraging AI to support operations and execution but not replace human taste and judgement. 

• A hands-on, creative, and highly accountable leader who thrives in ambiguity, moves quickly, and is comfortable building from the ground up.

Nice to Have

• Experience in networking, cybersecurity, infrastructure, developer tools, or AI.

• Experience scaling communications at a high-growth, global technology company.

• Experience supporting fundraising, acquisitions, or pre-IPO communications as well as experience supporting a company through an IPO.

• 

Experience collaborating with teams who support analyst relations, public policy, or major industry research initiatives.

Headquarters: Remote

PlanetScale is growing rapidly and reinventing the database space. The PlanetScale platform delivers a fully managed, multi-cloud Postgres service designed for the most demanding production workloads. We handle the complexity of provisioning, scaling, replication, and failover - so engineering teams can focus on building their products.

Our customers entrust us with their most precious digital asset, their data, so the stakes couldn't be higher. We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Postgres engineering team and help us build a world-class managed Postgres offering.

What's the job to be done?

• You will design and build the control plane that provisions, scales, and heals Postgres clusters with minimal customer-visible downtime.

• You will build and maintain high availability, disaster recovery, and data protection solutions that keep customer databases safe through infrastructure failures.

• You will tune Postgres to operate at scale for some of the largest and most demanding workloads in the world.

• You will build tooling and automation for database operations, backup, restore, and migration workflows - and participate in an on-call rotation.

• You will work directly with customers to understand their workloads and translate real-world needs into platform improvements.

These attributes best describe you…

• You have strong experience building, operating, or maintaining large-scale Postgres deployments in production.

• You have an excellent understanding of low-level operating systems concepts including multi-threading, memory management, networking, storage, and performance.

• You have strong fundamental computer science skills and can reason about distributed, fault-tolerant systems.

• You thrive in a collaborative environment, enjoy mentoring other engineers, and communicate complex technical tradeoffs clearly.

• You are self-motivated and can work independently with minimal guidance while making sound technical decisions.

What you will need

• 5+ years of software engineering experience designing, building, and supporting large-scale systems in production.

• Strong proficiency in Go, with experience in other languages like Ruby, Python, Zig or Rust.

• Experience building and maintaining distributed, fault-tolerant services.

• Working knowledge of Kubernetes and containerized applications.

• Experience building and operating distributed systems at scale.

What else will help you be successful

• Experience building or operating a database-as-a-service or managed database platform.

• Experience with connection pooling and proxy layers for Postgres.

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and infrastructure-as-code.

• Contributions to open-source projects, especially in the Postgres or database infrastructure space.

• Experience working with remote, geographically distributed teams.

• Previous experience at a high-growth technology company.

Why PlanetScale

We're redefining how high-growth companies manage data at scale—and we work with some of the most exciting brands in gaming, consumer tech, and B2B SaaS. As a Software Engineer, you'll be at the core of building the platform that powers world-class apps used by hundreds of millions of users worldwide. PlanetScale is a profitable company with a philosophy centered around building small teams of p99 individuals and is recognized as one of the fastest growing companies in America.

At PlanetScale we believe in supporting people to do their best work and thrive no matter the location. Our mission is to build a diverse, equitable, and inclusive company. We strive to build an inclusive environment where all people feel that they are equally respected and valued, whether they are a candidate or an employee. We welcome applicants of any educational background, gender identity and expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, citizenship, socioeconomic status, disability, pregnancy status, and veteran status.

If you have a disability, please let us know if there's any way we can make the interview process better for you; we're happy to accommodate!

Total Compensation and Pay Transparency

An employee's total compensation consists of base salary + variable comp where appropriate + benefits + equity. A member of our Talent Acquisition team will be happy to answer any further questions when we engage with you to begin the interview process.

Base salary range: $120,000 - $290,000 USD

9e23a0ee5d54f899.description: SalesMonk wants senior GTM engineers who build and own outbound into enterprise accounts, across a range of companies and markets. You decide which accounts to go after, get in front of the people who matter, and own the pipeline that comes out of it. This is fractional by design. In enterprise, the edge is judgment: reading what a company actually cares about, finding the angle that gets a senior executive to engage, and knowing when a direct pitch isn't the right way in. SalesMonk's internal team supports you along the way. **What you'll own (the 4 pillars)** **Pick the accounts that matter:** You choose the accounts worth pursuing, work out who really shapes the decision, and read the moments that put an account in play: a new leader, a new initiative, a line in an earnings call. Get the account and the timing right, and everything after it gets easier. **Sell directly, and write it well:** You run research-led outreach to the people who shape the decision, from the executive who owns the budget to the champion who will carry it internally. Each message speaks to what that person actually cares about, not to what you're selling. You know when to ask for a meeting and when to offer something useful first. **Open doors another way:** Some enterprise accounts won't respond to a pitch, however good it is. For those, you lead with something worth their time: a design partner seat, an advisory role, a research briefing on a problem they care about, or a partnership with clear upside for both sides. You build the advisor, partner, and customer relationships that make warm introductions possible, and you make sure every door you open leads back to a real sales conversation. **Turn research into a system:** Enterprise outbound depends on knowing more about an account than anyone else reaching out to it. You build the system that makes that possible at scale: maps of who matters in each account, live signals, the relationship paths into it, and AI that does the research before every email, call, or meeting. **What we're looking for** You think like a seller and build like an engineer. This role needs three skills that rarely live in the same senior person, and you need all of them. **GTM judgment:** you understand how large organizations actually make decisions: who has influence beyond the org chart, what makes a senior executive take a meeting, and when an account needs a direct pitch versus a different way in. **Copywriting:** you write with the precision senior executives expect. You can turn pages of research into one sharp observation, shift the message as it moves across a buying committee, and frame a partnership or advisory invitation so it reads as an opportunity, not a pitch. **Building:** you know the modern GTM stack well and can bring enrichment, intent, CRM, and AI together into something that runs reliably, account after account. Enterprise deals stall in predictable places: the wrong account, a single contact, a message that sounds like every other vendor. You know how to avoid all three. You can point to pipeline you generated, not activity you logged. You're patient without being slow, AI is already part of how you work, and you thrive with high autonomy. Deep expertise in one industry is as valuable as range across many. Prior fractional, advisory, or consulting experience is a plus. **What you'll need** * 6 to 15 years in outbound, growth, GTM engineering, RevOps, or demand generation, with significant time selling into enterprise. * Deep understanding of how enterprise buying works: committees, procurement, security reviews, and how a champion sells internally. * A track record of choosing the right enterprise accounts and opening them, reaching several people on the buying committee rather than one. * You write outbound copy yourself and can point to executive-level campaigns that drove replies and meetings. * Experience creating ways in beyond a direct pitch, and building the advisor, partner, or customer networks behind warm introductions. * Hands-on experience building account intelligence and outbound systems yourself, including at least one stood up from zero with numbers to show for it. **How we work** We measure on qualified opportunities per dollar of total spend (people + tooling), not calls or emails sent. Enterprise deals take time to close, but progress shouldn't: we expect the right conversations to open within weeks, not months.

Company Overview

Capwise Financial Services is a full-service investment banking and financial advisory firm that helps businesses raise capital, execute strategic transactions, and navigate complex financial decisions across domestic and cross-border markets. With experience spanning 200+ debt transactions and 35+ equity and M&A deals, the firm combines a strong origination network with an active deal pipeline and a partner-led model, where sector heads own their client franchise, revenue budgets, and teams, supported by Capwise’s broader platform, central origination network, and execution capabilities.

 Position Overview
 
We are seeking an experienced Investment Banking professional for our Consumer vertical. Unlike many investment banking roles, this position is primarily focused on transaction execution rather than cold origination. The firm will support deal sourcing and introductions.
Your role begins once a prospect is identified or a warm introduction is made. You will present the firm's execution capabilities, finalize mandate documents, and lead the end-to-end execution of fund-raising (equity/debt) and Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) transactions.

 Key Responsibilities

1. Mandate Closure & Onboarding
•    Pitch to Win: Partner with the origination team during initial introductions to present deep sectoral knowledge and bespoke execution strategies that convert prospects into clients.
•    Mandate Structuring: Draft, negotiate, and finalize Mandate Letters, Engagement Agreements, and fee structures, ensuring the commercial interests of the firm are protected.

2. End-to-End Deal Execution
•    Transaction Management: Lead and oversee the entire lifecycle of capital raising (PE, IPO, Structured Finance) and M&A (buy-side, sell-side, joint ventures) transactions.
•    Financial Modeling & Valuation: Supervise the creation of complex financial models, valuation analyses (DCF, comparable companies, precedent transactions), and investment thesis formulations.
•    Collateral Preparation: Ensure the highest quality production of pitch books, Confidential Information Memorandums (CIMs), Teasers, and Management Presentations.

3. Due Diligence & Deal Closing
•    Data Room Management: Setup and oversee Virtual Data Rooms (VDR), managing the flow of information between clients, investors, and buyers.
•    Due Diligence Coordination: Lead the financial, legal, tax, and commercial due diligence processes, actively resolving deal-breakers and bottlenecks.
•    Definitive Documentation: Collaborate with legal counsels to negotiate and finalize Share Purchase Agreements (SPA), Share Subscription Agreements (SSA), Shareholders' Agreements (SHA), and other definitive transaction documents.

4. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management
•    Pod Leadership: Manage, mentor, and maximize the productivity of a dedicated team of Managers, Associates, and Analysts within your vertical.
•    Client Management: Act as the primary, trusted point of contact for C-suite executives and promoters throughout the execution cycle, managing expectations and maintaining momentum.

 Qualifications & Experience

•    Education: MBA from a Tier-1 business school, Chartered Accountant (CA), or CFA.
•    Experience: 7 to 9+ years of core investment banking experience within a reputed IB firm, institutional platform, or boutique advisory house.
•    Track Record: A proven history of independently closing mid-to-large cap M&A and fundraising transactions. Must be able to demonstrate an extensive list of closed deals where you acted as a primary execution lead.
•    Sector Expertise: Deep domain knowledge, regulatory understanding, and active investor networks within the Consumer vertical.
•    Skills: Strong negotiation skills, sound understanding of legal documentation/deal structures, and sharp analytical acumen.

Job Title: Senior Finance Analyst 

Role: Business Partnering, Finance

Location: Bengaluru

Job Summary

We’re seeking a strategic and driven Senior Financial Analyst – FP&A, to join our dynamic Global Finance Team. This is more than a numbers role – it’s a chance to shape the financial future of a fast-growing company. This Bengaluru-based role is embedded within the nerve center of financial planning and performance reporting. You will be entrusted with providing financial insights that drive decision-making and operational excellence, consolidated financials, working directly with senior stakeholders. This is your chance to be part of a high-impact team where your insights will shape strategy and fuel growth. We value innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning—and we’re excited to grow with you.

Key Responsibilities

• Business Partnership: Serve as a trusted finance partner to FP&A Partners and leadership teams, delivering actionable insights on business drivers, performance, risks, and opportunities to support strategic and operational decisions. 
• Planning, Forecasting & Reporting: Lead budgeting, forecasting, long-range and investment planning, and monthly performance reporting with variance analysis on business performance, resource utilization, and financial outcomes. 
• Executive Reporting & Decision Support: Prepare executive-level presentations and business reviews that translate complex financial and operational data into clear, concise insights for senior leadership. 
• Financial Data Modelling: Build and maintain models for revenue, expenses, headcount, business scenarios, and sensitivity analysis. Manage capacity models to inform headcount planning and expense forecasting. 
• Financial Analysis and Insights: Perform structured and ad hoc analyses to identify trends, explain variances, evaluate scenarios, and provide actionable insights to executive team. 
• Performance Storytelling: Translate financial and operational data into clear narratives and visual outputs for finance and non-finance stakeholders. 
• Process Improvement: Drive continuous improvement in processes by leveraging technology, automation, data analytics, and emerging AI capabilities while proactively identifying opportunities to enhance efficiency and insights. 
• Process Improvement and AI Adoption: Proactively explore and apply AI, automation, and analytics to improve accuracy, standardize analysis, simplify processes, and increase reporting efficiency 

Qualifications & Experience

• Chartered Accountant (CA), & MBA in Finance from a top-tier institution. 
• 3-5 years of progressive experience in FP&A—ideally in software or payments industry. 
• Experience supporting budgeting, forecasting, consolidation, variance analysis, management reporting, and financial modelling. 
• Experience working with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams in a deadline-driven environment. 

Technical Skills & Competencies

• Strong grounding in accounting fundamentals, financial modelling, forecasting, and scenario planning. 
• Knowledge in tools: Snowflake (for data extraction/joins), Alteryx (for workflows and transformations), Power BI (for visual analytics), and advanced Excel (modeling, pivots, lookups, arrays), basics of Python (good to have, not mandatory skillset). 
• Experience with Adaptive Planning or similar Planning & Budgeting tools. 
• Reasonable understanding of SaaS metrics, financial KPIs, and technology-driven business models. 
• Excellent communication and stakeholder engagement skills 

Preferred Attributes

• Highly dynamic individual comfortable with rapid changes and evolving priorities. 
• Questions the data, understands the “why,” and seeks to improve. 
• Detail-oriented and committed to delivering accurate, high-stakes work under tight deadlines. 
• Demonstrates strong analytical and problem-solving mindset. 
• Known for delivering accurate, high-stake work under tight deadlines with limited supervision. 
• Enthusiastic about learning and applying AI, automation, and emerging analytical tools to FP&A. 
• Enjoys working with sophisticated financial tools and data analytics platforms. 

Why Join Us?

At Bottomline, we are transforming the way businesses pay and get paid. As a global leader in business payments and cash management, we provide secure, comprehensive solutions that modernize payments for businesses and financial institutions worldwide. With over 35 years of expertise and more than $16 trillion in payments processed annually, we are committed to delivering innovative financial solutions that add to the bottom line.

Bottomline is a portfolio company of Thoma Bravo, one of the largest software private equity firms in the world, with more than $166 billion in assets under management. Our success is driven by our passionate, motivated, and resourceful team members who collaborate, innovate, and push boundaries to create world-class financial products and experiences.

We operate as One Global Team, empowering one another through our Guiding Principles, which shape our culture and drive our customer-centric approach. By joining us, you will be part of a dynamic environment where ideas are valued, leadership is encouraged, and your contributions help reshape the future of business payments.

• Be part of a high-growth FinTech company disrupting the industry with innovative solutions. 
• Work closely with global leadership and gain cross-functional exposure. 
• Lead a high-performing FP&A team and shape the financial strategy of the organization. 
• Competitive compensation and career growth opportunities. 

We welcome talent at all career stages and are dedicated to understanding and supporting additional needs. We're proud to be an equal opportunity employer, committed to creating an inclusive and open environment for everyone.
